name: Enviroment
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the Creator of the heavens and the earth, having completed all things in creation (Genesis 1:1; 2:1). Man was placed in the garden to actively care for and maintain it (Genesis 2:15), reflecting a divine responsibility to steward the environment. The law further instructs respect for natural resources, forbidding the destruction of trees during warfare because the tree of the field is considered man's life (Deuteronomy 20:19). Additionally, God's preservation of all creation, including the earth and seas, underscores His sovereign care over the environment (Nehemiah 9:6).
